GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><div> <div> <div class="enabled-managed-focus-container"> <div class="tabbed_channel__Abx5r"> <div class="tabbed_channel__Abx5r"> <div class="channel_tab_panel__zJ5Bt"> <div> <div> <div> <div id="message-list"> <div id="message-list"> <div> <div> <div> <div id="message-list_1788418469.703149"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><strong>Intermediate Backend Engineer<br><br>About the role</strong><br>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer, you will take backend features and improvements from clarifying the problem through shipping them and following up in production. You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.<br><br><strong>Why you’ll love this role</strong></div> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.</li> <li><strong>Learning and Growth :</strong> You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.</li> <li><strong>Innovative Culture:</strong> You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy:</strong> You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.</li> <li><strong>User-Centric Collaboration:</strong> You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.</li> </ul> <div><strong>What you’ll do</strong></div> <ul> <li><strong>Own and Ship Features:</strong> Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.</li> <li><strong>Build for Production:</strong> Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.</li> <li><strong>Test and Review:</strong> Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.</li> <li><strong>Operate What You Build:</strong> Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> <li><strong>Leverage AI:</strong> Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.</li> </ul> <div><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></div> <ul> <li><strong>Backend Fundamentals:</strong> Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.</li> <li><strong>Adaptability:</strong> Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.</li> <li><strong>Feature Ownership:</strong> The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.</li> <li><strong>Practical Judgment:</strong> Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.</li> <li><strong>Clear Communication:</strong> Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li><strong>AI Fluency:</strong> Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Helpful experience</strong></div> <ul> <li>Production Go services, APIs, concurrency, profiling, or gRPC.</li> <li>Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.</li> <li>Rust, particularly for systems, security, performance, or platform work.</li> <li>PostgreSQL, schema evolution, caching, queues, messaging, or event-driven workflows.</li> <li>Observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.</li> <li>Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About DevRev</strong></span></p> <p>At DevRev, we're building the future of work with <em>Computer</em> – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, <em>Computer</em> unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.<br><br></p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Customer-facing:</strong>&nbsp;30% working directly with customers.</li> <li><strong>Coding &amp; Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation</strong></li> <li><strong>Build &amp; Deploy Solutions:</strong>&nbsp;Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.</li> <li><strong>Integrate Systems:</strong>&nbsp;Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.</li> <li><strong>Optimize AI Performance:</strong>&nbsp;Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.</li> <li><strong>Own Data Insights:</strong>&nbsp;Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.</li> <li><strong>Prototype &amp; Iterate:</strong>&nbsp;Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.</li> <li><strong>Lead Cross-functional Collaboration:</strong>&nbsp;Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.</li> <li><strong>Guide Technical Adoption:</strong>&nbsp;Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.</li> <li><strong>Travel Ready:</strong> <strong>Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Background:</strong>&nbsp;Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.</li> <li><strong>Coding Skills:</strong>&nbsp;Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)</li> <li><strong>Applied AI Knowledge:</strong>&nbsp;Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.</li> <li><strong>Integration Expertise:</strong>&nbsp;Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.</li> <li><strong>Cloud &amp; Deployment:</strong>&nbsp;Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).</li> <li><strong>Data Transformation:</strong>&nbsp;Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.</li> <li><strong>Observability:</strong>&nbsp;Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.</li> <li><strong>Context-Aware Systems:</strong>&nbsp;Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.</li> <li><strong>Problem-Solving:</strong>&nbsp;Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.</li> <li><strong>Documentation:</strong>&nbsp;Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong>&nbsp;Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.<br><br>As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.</em></p></div>

<div class="content-intro"><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="color: rgb(22, 145, 121);"><strong>Netradyne</strong></span> harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.</p></div><p><strong>Job Overview:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Associate Database Engineer with 6 months to 1 year of experience in managing databases in either on-premises or AWS cloud environments. The ideal candidate should possess foundational knowledge of database administration, cloud services, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and operational support. The role involves supporting the provisioning, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, backup, security, and optimisation of database platforms such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, and AWS RDS (PostgreSQL, Aurora PostgreSQL). You will work closely with senior database engineers, application teams, DevOps engineers, and cloud infrastructure teams to ensure reliable and efficient database operations.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong>​</p> <ul> <li>Assist in provisioning and managing database infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.</li> <li>Support database configuration, deployment, and automation using Ansible playbooks.</li> <li>Administer and maintain self managed (hosted on aws ec2) databases and AWS managed databases such has Elasticache, RDS, Opensearch, DynamoDB, Nepture.,</li> <li>Monitor database health, performance, availability, and capacity using Datadog, AWS CloudWatch, Grafana and other monitoring tools.</li> <li>Perform routine database administration tasks including user management, backup verification, patching, upgrades, and maintenance activities.</li> <li>Assist in identifying and resolving database performance issues, alerts, incidents, and service requests.</li> <li>Support database backup, restore, disaster recovery, and high availability configurations.</li> <li>Participate in database migration and upgrade projects.</li> <li>Maintain database security standards, access controls, and compliance requirements.</li> <li>Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.</li> <li>Collaborate with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams during application deployments and troubleshooting activities.</li> <li>Participate in on-call support rotations as required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Mandatory Skills:</strong>​</p> <ul> <li>Basic administration knowledge of PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, or AWS RDS.</li> <li>Experience managing databases in on-premises or AWS cloud environments.</li> <li>Exposure to Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and Ansible for configuration management.</li> <li>Knowledge of Linux administration, SQL, database backup &amp; recovery concepts.</li> <li>Experience with monitoring tools such as Datadog and AWS CloudWatch.</li> <li>Understanding of database performance monitoring, high availability, security, and troubleshooting.</li> <li>Familiarity with Git, scripting (Shell/Bash or Python), and DevOps automation practices.</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications and Education Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>6 months to 1 year of experience in database administration, cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support.</li> <li>Internship experience in database or cloud technologies will be considered.</li> <li>·AWS Cloud Practitioner / AWS Associate certification is an added advantage.</li> <li>Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Good verbal and written communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to learn new database and cloud technologies quickly and work effectively in a team environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: justify;">We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team.
